While the game still seems to be in development, the current version provides enough challenge and replay-ability at a decent price. I would describe this game as a cross between Missile Command and Steam World Dig. You alternate between dome defense and harvesting resources as quick and efficiently as you can before the next defense phase.

Definitely an excellent under $20 buy if you like digging tunnels and playing Space Invaders. Not the most Rogue-lite Rogue-lite, but a good time.

Updated for Assessor and Guild features: Still a great, great game, now with different highlights in the mining / space invaders experience!

I've done a disservice by playing this game since launch and never reviewing it. I am in love with Dome Keeper. The art and music is beautiful, and the sense of discovery has kept me playing for almost 3 years. I cannot recommend this game enough!

Ok this is VERY early into the game. I checked the demo out after watching Splattercat playing it and I weirdly enough enjoyed it.

Now the game is out and I've been having fun, I'm just unsure of how long the game will keep it's appeal. Will give it an upvote for now, might change it later if I get bored after 5 hours and there's nothing gamechanging coming =)

Edit: 3 hours in now and everything is unlocked (it was unlocked before my last run but I had to do one more to see if there was anything else).

So for almost 20 Euros I can't say it's worth it if you're like me and feel like a game is finished once you've done everything.

But I will leave the review as a positive one since the developer said he's gonna add more things to the game, so we'll see later down the line if this will stay positive or not =)

I have watched people play this game before and I thought it looked super cool and fun; that's exactly how I'd describe this game. The graphics are super cute and while the goal of this game is simple, it's gameplay is far from boring as you must collect resources and fight monsters to keep your dome alive. It's quite an enjoyable game, reminds me of Dig Dug.

I've been playing this game since it was a demo in itchio. The full game is amazing and has an addictive gameplay loop, I love the art style and music, it has lots of modes and stuff to unlock. Devs are constantly adding new content and balancing existing content based on community feedback (join the discord). Highly recommend this game

2024 Update: The devs are still hard at work and have been adding content for free this entire time. I still highly recommend this game after putting hundreds of hours into it over the various updates, added content, and balance changes. The devs are very responsive in their discord to player suggestions. Worth the money.

Dome Keeper is a Survival Base building Rouge-like game where you have to defend your dome against waves of alien creatures. In between these waves of attacks you have to dig under your dome to find 3 basic resources to upgrade your dome and your weapons to fend of the creatures.

Pros
- Very easy to get into.
- Beautiful pixel art & music
- Multiple difficulties and map sizes

Cons
- Could use a very basic tutorial for people who may be new to games like these.
- Nothing else as such for me personally.

I am very happy with the game. Having said that the game is going to get updates so might make more sense to wait a bit and get it when there is more content. Currently there are 2 main modes in the game. Also for a game like this a little sale would help a bit as well. I get good regional pricing so its fine for me but I can see where the other reviewers are coming from.
Overall this is one of the best Indie games I have played and will check it out more when there are a few more updates.

Got the game through HumbleBundle (or similar) and installed it on a hunch - never regretted it. Digging, exploring, ressource gathering & going through the skill-tree during the "day" & defending against monsters at "night" (or rather monsterwave & time in between). The gameplay changes depending on a bunch of choices you make before or during a session > every tower, tower-extenshion, mining-avatar, skill, etc has a totally different playstyle & changes the whole game again and again. 2h per session, perfectly ADHD approved with calm focus on mining & building, with regular interruptions of action via monsterkilling every couple of minutes. Awesome game!

It's a relatively relaxed game that nevertheless challenges you.
I haven't played it in a while and am delighted with the QoL updates.

As the game currently is, I can't recommend it especially at the current price. I do think the game has massive potential, but some of the annoyances I have are leading me to write this review. The game started off very enjoyable, but soon became rather repetitive. The different styles of play don't really give any benefit. Two times the materials but the cost is twice as much? What in the world is the point of that? Sure there are ways to make the game more challenging, but not in an entertaining way. I had really hoped that the newest update would make the game more enjoyable. Instead, the game gave a new character with very clunky mechanics and a ridiculous upgrade tree. I do hope that this game does continue to improve, but I am currently disappointed.

I love this game so much already. Each run has been about 45 minutes to an hour for me, which is perfect. Its just random enough to stay interesting, though I really hope they add more small unlockables like suits/pets/maps so that there's more of a reason to keep exploring. I've been reading the updates as well, the devs seem to be putting a lot of thought into how to make different domes and characters play differently to make each run unique, and it really shows with just the 4 options the game has so far. When you start playing, you will get better at the game by learning how to play and also buying upgrades which stay with you. They have achieved such a perfect balance between the learning and the upgrading that you will quickly become super addicted and you'll have a crazy amount of fun...and you will keep on playing and starting a new run after new run without getting bored because of the RNG elements. It's a genius combination of factors to produce the most harrowing level of addiction and I can't recommend it enough!

Dome Keeper

Well everyone seems to like it but actually this game is stupid especially when you consider it costs £15.

So you start in your dome and you're slow, weak and useless, you find your yellow cubes, upgrade your speed, drill strength and carry capacity. So you're getting stronger and then mobs attack your dome, okay your run back and defend it, at some point you upgrade your dome weapon and repeat this until you find the mega artifact, which will trigger a final wave, you survive that and congratz you win!

When you win you can choose a perk, like different dome or starting bonus like shield or orchard or different character to play. I will tell you a secret starting char is better, the other one is crap.

After the victory or defeat it's all over again ad infinitum. Dunno, nothing there to charge 15 pounds for, not worth it, can't recommend
